verdict.rationale: Navan documents receipt scanning for expenses and AI-assisted policy auditing: Ava compares spend to company policy, and the MCP can surface flagged expenses, rideshare policy violations, and the reasons a transaction was flagged. Nothing shows AI automatically coding expenses, suggesting categories or memos, or detecting duplicates or fraud. missing for 10: AI auto-categorization/coding of expenses, AI-suggested memos, duplicate detection, fraud detection, evidence that receipt scanning is AI-driven extraction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
